title: Routine: morning brief, every weekday
html:
Every weekday at 7am, give me a morning brief: the top 3 news stories for small coffee shops in the Philippines, one line each with the source.

What it doesgive me a morning brief: the top 3 news stories for small coffee shops in the Philippines, one line each with the source.

Set. I will do this every weekday at 07:00, on this machine, and keep the result. Say show my routines to see the latest one. Here is the first one now, so you can see what it looks like.
Here is your morning brief:

1. Philippine coffee production could fall below 30,000 metric tons in 2026 due to El Niño drought and rising costs. Source: BWorldPH / BusinessMirror

2. Pickup Coffee expands aggressively, hitting 500 stores and targeting the top spot in the fast-growing market. Source: World Coffee Portal

3. Jollibee Group launches its first Compose Coffee store in the Philippines, with a five-year nationwide expansion plan. Source: Jollibee Group / MarktechAPAC
